title: Missions
description: Give an agent an objective with acceptance checks. Success is judged by the checks, not by what the agent says.
createAdminOnly: Creating a mission requires the admin role
disabledTitle: Missions are disabled on this gateway
disabledHint: Set GOCLAW_MISSIONS=1 (and GOCLAW_MISSIONS_SOURCE_ROOT) and restart the gateway. Verifier commands run on the host executor.
emptyDescription: Create a mission from a contract to see verified results here.

create.title: New mission
create.hint: Paste or edit a mission contract (JSON). Paths are relative to the gateway's mission source root.

detail.criteriaPending: Checks run after the agent finishes.
detail.summaryHint: The agent's own narrative. It is not evidence; the checks above are.
detail.confirmCancelHint: The agent run is stopped and the mission is marked cancelled.
detail.usageIncomplete: An attempt ended without reporting its usage (for example the gateway restarted), so token and cost totals are a lower bound.
detail.toolCallsHint: Recorded before each call ran. "Started" without an outcome means the result was never acknowledged.
